Hello,

Your physiotherapy referral has been received, and we're now arranging your sessions. We've noted that you prefer morning appointments and will do our best to match that. You'll hear from us soon with the details of your first session.

Wishing you a smooth recovery. Please reach out if you have any questions in the meantime.

Warm regards,
The Care Coordination Team
